## Instructions

1. Preheat the oven to 350 °F and butter a loaf pan.
2. Mix the bananas and melted butter, then the sugar and the egg.
3. Stir in the baking soda and the flour.
4. Bake 60 to 70 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
